run_benchmark_wrapper: run the xFormers benchmark wrapper script with a benchmark script name and benchmark function name as arguments
test_benchmark_regression: test the benchmark wrapper for regressions by running a benchmark with --fail_if_regression flag
compare_benchmark_results: compare benchmark results against a cached baseline CSV file on matching hardware
build_benchmark_command: build a subprocess command to run a xFormers benchmark with label, function, and comparison flags
manage_benchmark_cache: manage benchmark cache by removing original CSV files and renaming new results as reference
